notes: Villány makes robust, full bodied, spicy reds, and Szekszárd full bodied reds with a little spice.
Balaton and Somló, largely on volcanic soils, make full bodied whites with considerable to high acidity.
Eger's Bikavér, or Bull's Blood, is a robust red blend.
Hungarian Cabernet Franc is full bodied and tannic, with spice, blue flowers and red and black berries.
Tokaji aszú, made from the best of the Furmint harvest, is famously long lived, described as nearly immortal.
